profile.headline: Software Developer | Software Development & Automation
profile.summary:
A full-stack software developer who loves building clean, scalable solutions that make complex problems feel simple. Over the past few years I’ve worked across the stack (with React, TypeScript, .NET, C#, PowerShell, and SQL) designing reliable systems that balance performance, maintainability, and user experience.

I most enjoy collaborating with cross-functional teams, writing thoughtful code, and creating software that’s intuitive, performant, and built to last.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
● Built internal automation solutions for extending database functions making processes more efficient
● Modernized legacy solutions and improved code quality to lay groundwork for migration goals
● Resolved bugs and shipped new features across internal systems, improved system reliability

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
● Worked collaboratively with cross-functional teams throughout the software development lifecycle
● Lead technical initiatives and participated in architectural decisions
● Established and improved software development frameworks, principles, and processes across the team
● Mentored junior developers and guided code review processes

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
● Designed, developed, and tested in-house automation solutions in support of IT operations
● Created full-stack cloud applications to manage staff & admin workflows
● Assisted in creation of new development processes to align development with Agile methodology
● Provided support for larger development efforts
